India Condemns Pakistan Air Strikes on Afghan Territory

The Indian government has strongly condemned Pakistan's air strikes on Afghan territory, reiterating its support for Afghanistan's sovereignty and territorial integrity. The MEA statement describes the strikes as a 'direct threat to regional peace'. India has called for restraint and de-escalation of tensions in the region. The incident highlights the ongoing tensions between India and Pakistan over Kashmir.
